provenance.whatThisRecords: The implementation author response from the authorized bounded-remediation Task 10 chain. It returned one fenced AgentResult containing two Python-style \\U0001f319 escapes, at zero-based positions 1911 and 9505 of the fenced body. JSON permits \\u followed by four hexadecimal digits but not \\U followed by eight, so the implementation stage recorded implementation.content.invalid and blocked before applying a patch.
provenance.provesWhat: Production extractJsonBody returns refused with 'fenced block is not valid JSON: Bad escaped character in JSON at position 1912 (line 1 column 1913)'. Replacing only the two invalid escapes in memory with the literal U+1F319 character makes extraction succeed and validateAgentResult accept an implementer result with five patch files. This confirms malformed result JSON as the measured block; it does not establish that the unapplied patch would pass deterministic guards, verification, or code review.
provenance.droppedFromEnvelope: session_id, uuid, and per-request timing fields (duration_api_ms, ttft_ms, ttft_stream_ms, time_to_request_ms, first_content_frame_ms, queued_turn_count) are dropped because they identify one provider session or vary per invocation and no contract reads them.
provenance.sanitized: The retained result contains no absolute machine path, secret, or signing material. Its result body is otherwise byte-for-byte as retained.
